name: it-helpdesk-password-reset
description: Voice agent template: an IT help desk agent that calls an employee back through Teams Phone extensibility after they ask for a password reset, verifies them on the call, and completes the reset on a web page that moves in step with the call.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs src/providers/*.mjs src/voice/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs public/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done; echo "syntax ok"
